title: RemedyTable
description: Maps covered failure modes to the limited adjudicated remedies v0 can execute: full release, full refund, neutral mutual cancellation, or arbitration of a challenged verdict. On-chain mutual cancellation atomically consumes one party's EIP-712 offer through the counterparty; the single-use offer is bound to the deal's exact revision and expires within at most one hour. Arbitration is all-or-nothing - the arbitrator contract rules Release or Refund, the losing challenger forfeits the challenger bond, and a ruling of Refund is the only path that slashes the seller bond; v0 cannot execute other partial payments or remedies.
